## Test-only campaign launcher

Roster source: Authoritative Blog Article Distribution workbook (Locations, Wordpress Sites, Doctor Census, Test User). Only Test users at TEST-1 can be selected. The final page shows recipients and requires the exact SEND TEST INVITATIONS phrase. The guarded BigQuery write creates a test campaign and queues invitations for the existing dispatcher. No general-dentist campaign, WordPress publication, or static-site release occurs here. Keep the original launcher inactive.
